summary: Investigate why the user still sees the EEG timebase artifact after source changes.

intervals.description: Compare recording, source modification times, and the still-running project-local Python process to determine whether the updated rendering code was loaded.
evidence: User report: the EEG issue still occurs
Project-local Python process started at 2026-11-05 15:39:34 Europe/Rome

results: The recording and the still-running Python process both predate the adaptive decimation source change, so neither demonstrates the updated code. The process was left running to avoid interrupting a possible live LSL session.
Previous verification used fresh processes and deterministic synthetic signals; it did not verify the user's active session.
open_items: Restart the current project-local viewer so it imports the updated source, then verify the EEG behavior again with the live or simulated stream.
limitations: The process command line was unavailable, so its exact entry point could not be confirmed. No active process was terminated.
